sisi.depan: A small shrine built of dark volcanic stone has a low, open doorway from which hangs a single bronze lantern, revealing a section of an interior wall carved with a relief of stylized flora and cosmic patterns.
sisi.kanan: A narrow path marked by low, snow-dusted stone posts winds up the hill past a solitary, windswept conifer and the edge of a small, ice-covered pond.
sisi.kiri: A cluster of gnarled, leafless trees and several large, moss-covered boulders emerge from the deep snow on the slope of a neighbouring hill.
sisi.belakang: The snowy hillside falls away into a vast, deep valley that stretches towards a distant horizon of jagged mountain peaks.
sisi.tengah: A single, weathered stone pillar, half-buried in the snow, stands facing the shrine.
sisi.atas: A heavy, uniform grey sky is filled with thick, slow-moving snow clouds.
